collection.title: Mitsubishi Pajero 2007 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mitsubishi Pajero 2007 Onwards model requires a 22" wiper blade size on the drivers side and a 20" blade size on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this Pajero, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
